about_the_game:
Bru & Boegie: Episode 1 - Get da MILK!

A hand-drawn 2D comedy point-and-click adventure game.

You are Bru.
You need milk for your coffee.
YOH. The stakes are hectic.

Slip into the underpants of Bru, a hard-boiled man-child on a mission: get milk for da coffee. Point and click your way through a hand-drawn and animated world, featuring a fully-voiced cast of weirdo townsfolk, and a groovy original soundtrack.

Inspired by classic Lucasarts point-and-click adventures like Sam & Max: Hit the Road and Day of the Tentacle, this bite-size puzzle adventure serves up a generous dose of ridiculousness that you can complete in a single sitting.

This is the first episode in a trilogy of Bru & Boegie games. 

  • One-Button Gameplay: So intuitive, even your grandma can master it.

  • Interactions deluxe: More unique actions than you can shake a stick at.

  • Rarefied Humour: Enjoy bizarre characters, non sequiturs and irreverent small-batch bespoke conspiracy theories.

  • Original Hand-Drawn Art & Animation: Made by human hands - nice.

  • Fully-Human Voiced Cast: Almost 1,000 dialogue entries, all fully-voiced by real people.

  • Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud Saves: dragging Bru & Boegie kicking and screaming into the digital future.

  • Enhanced Audio: This version has improved audio mixing and reprocessed voice audio, making it the best way to experience the game.

  • Original Music Score: Boppin’ tunes to make you feel KIFF.

  • Mini-Games! Stop the intrusive thoughts from infiltrating your mind in 'Meditation HERO', and complete Bru’s sticker page with the 15 stickers hidden around the world to unlock a surprise.

  • You Can’t Die: Low stress, max lols.

From the Community:

"I have never played a game this funny..." - Krizezivota

"BRILLIANT. Loved every single thing about it." - latetothegames

"I honestly f*cking loved every minute of this! So witty and clever, all the little comments about the state of the world as well, just brilliant. Great little character and characters, and the voice acting was on par too! I really hope we get more episodes, like, Get Da Sugaaaa!" - VonWeavey

“Absolute masterpiece.” - ♥ 𝑨𝒍𝒆𝒏𝒆 ♥

"i just finished the game, i just love it, i think this is my new favorite game, or one of them..." - dunkkke

"Amazing and unhinged game, I loved it 🤣” - hyprZona

“I LOVE THIS” - Jaelix
